messages:
acme_ops: Hey team, hitting 401 invalid_api_key for a hosted request. Customer says they copied the key from the Dashboard and pasted it into their curl.

jess_support: Sorry about that — can you paste the exact curl and the response body (redact key) so we can repro quickly? :mag:

acme_ops: Here's what they pasted (redacted):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer rk_live_MVZf...-2026-03-18T12:34:56Z\" \
  -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
```
Response: 401 {"error":"invalid_api_key","message":"API key not found"}

jess_support: Huh — looks like the key string has an ISO timestamp appended (`-2026-03-18T12:34:56Z`). Can you confirm the dashboard copy button might be adding that?

devon_engineer: Marking for triage — that appended suffix would change key length and break hashing/lookup. If true this is a UI bug during copy.

ingrid_sre: Quick repro on my side: I opened the key modal -> click copy -> pasted into a scratch file and I see `rk_live_...-2026-03-18T12:34:56Z`.

jess_support: Thanks Ingrid. acme_ops, ask customer to try re-copying and also try trimming everything after the last alnum char of the key (i.e., remove the `-2026...` suffix) — if their request succeeds it's definitely a copy artifact.

acme_ops: They tried removing the suffix and the same curl with header `Authorization: Bearer rk_live_MVZf...` returned 200. So it's the suffix.

jess_support: Great repro. Workaround: manually remove the hyphen+timestamp or regen & copy the new key. We'll escalate to eng to patch the copy behavior.

devon_engineer: Two quick asks for debug: 1) browser + OS + clipboard manager? 2) devtools console screenshot when clicking copy (to see if we append metadata client-side). Anyone see related alerts from deploybot?

acme_ops: Customer using Chrome 111 on MacOS, no clipboard manager. They shared a screenshot — copy button displays a tiny tooltip that shows the key with a trailing light-gray timestamp.

deploybot: deploy notification: release/console-ui v2.18.4 -> prod at 2026-03-18T12:30:00Z (started)

devon_engineer: That release likely changed how we render key rows (we added a last-used label). Looks like our copy code concatenates key + ' - ' + lastUsedISO for display and accidentally copies the whole display string instead of the raw key.

ingrid_sre: Repro steps for eng:
1) Go to Console -> API Keys -> any key row.
2) Hover to reveal last-used timestamp.
3) Click copy icon.
4) Paste into terminal -> observe `-YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ` appended.

devon_engineer: I'll open a bug (ENG-4312) and attach console UI diff. Short-term patch: change clipboard.copy() target to rawKey value. I'll roll a quick hotfix if CI green.

jess_support: Action items for support: 1) Notify affected customer with workaround and ETA for fix. 2) Offer a temporary regenerated key if they want. 3) Add note to status page if multiple customers hit this.

acme_ops: Customer accepted workaround and regenerated a key, all good now. Please keep me posted on ENG-4312.

devon_engineer: ENG-4312 created, assigning to frontend. ETA: hotfix in next patch (2026-03-18T14:00Z).

ingrid_sre: Postmortem note: this is a client-side UX bug causing malformed token copy; no backend auth regression. No rollback required.

jess_support: Closing loop with customer now. Thanks team :tada:

acme_ops: Thanks everyone, saved the deployment window.

devon_engineer: Patch merged, hotfix deployed to prod at 2026-03-18T13:50:12Z — copying now verified to paste raw key only.

jess_support: Customer confirmed they can now copy/paste without the timestamp. Closing thread.
